title: Line sketch: Barn in Misty Fields
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A weathered barn with a rusty roof sits amid rolling and fields, flanked by scattered trees and simple fences under a hazy sky. The composition leads the eye from the textured foreground grasses toward the distant tree line using atmospheric perspective. Soft blended edges and muted color transitions evoke a calm rural scene painted with smooth, layered technique (derived from painting #45).
